ru.name: Vertiv ER22020-T Промышленный блок питания
ru.desc: The Vertiv ER22020-T is a 4.4kW high-power switch-mode rectifier module delivering 220Vdc/20A for utility substations and critical industrial DC systems. Powered by full DSP digital control and LLC resonant conversion, it provides industry-leading electrical stability across extreme temperatures.
advantages: 4.4kW Power Density: Provides 20A continuous utility charging current, significantly saving panel footprint.
LLC Resonant Design: Minimizes switching losses, ensures uniform thermal distribution, and extends MTBF by >40%.
Three-Phase Neutral-Free: Eliminates floating neutral burn-out risks, ideal for industrial grid environments.
Dual Hardware OVP: Redundant hardware-triggered overvoltage protection isolates the unit instantly to protect battery banks.

faqs.q: How are CAN addresses assigned when multiple ER22020-T modules run in parallel?
faqs.a: The modules feature slot-ID automatic addressing through backplane pin coding, allowing the master supervisory controller to automatically recognize and enumerate each rectifier.

faqs.q: How can we purchase batch-tested ER22020-T units with load bank verification?
faqs.a: Reach out via WhatsApp (+86 17621197907) for dynamic load test records, ripple measurements, and secure worldwide export packaging.

ar.desc: The ZTE ZXD4000 (V5.0) is a carrier-grade high-power switch-mode rectifier module delivering -48V/80A (4000W) of stable DC power for central offices, mobile core facilities, and high-density telecom cabinets. Engineered with digital power topology and high-speed bus sharing, it represents the backbone of high-capacity telecom power systems.
advantages: 80A Flagship High Current: Delivers 4000W per module, reducing the total subrack count needed for large central office sites.
Digital Autonomous Sharing: Proprietary digital communication ensures < ±3% load sharing without external balancing controllers.
Severe Grid Resilience: Enhanced input lightning and surge suppression guarantees clean, stable DC power across generator switchovers.
Intelligent Energy Eco-Mode: Communicates with ZTE ZXDU controllers to cycle rectifiers into sleep mode during light-load hours to save energy.

faqs.q: What causes all front panel indicators on the ZTE ZXD4000 (V5.0) to stay dark?
faqs.a: Verify that the rear subrack AC input breaker has not tripped and that the blind-mate pins are firmly engaged. In severe lightning cases, the internal AC input fuse may have blown and should be continuity-tested.

faqs.q: Is the ZXD4000 compatible with ZTE ZXDU68 large cabinet systems?
faqs.a: Yes. The ZXD4000 (V5.0) is the factory-standard rectifier for high-capacity ZXDU68 cabinets (e.g. T601/T901), fully recognized by the CSU central controller.
